text:
Ivy: Huge shoutout to Oscar for swooping in during my solo demo when the slide deck decided to ghost me  saved the day with a quick screen-share and calm commentary  seriously appreciated.

Oscar: Was happy to help! Swapped to the backup PDF and forwarded the annotated notes. Command I used to get the PDF: `open ~/demos/moonshot/backup.pdf`  glad it worked.

Tess: Loved how Alex jumped in to summarize the roadmap while Ivy got reconnected  teamwork. :raised_hands:

Alex: Small things: I clipped the Q&A and added a short note to the demo doc: https://redwood.internal/demos/moonshot (timestamp + slide index)

Rohan: KUDOS CHAIN TIME  Oscar gets the first. Been meaning to say thanks for being on-call during demo rotations.

kudos-bot: Rohan gave Oscar a "Slide Saviour" kudos (reason: instant screen-share) :sparkles:

Ivy: Also a big thanks to Ops-bot for the reconnect reminder  that nudge helped me join the call faster.

ops-bot: Reminder sent: "Join call using fallback link" to @Ivy at 14:02 PT. :bell:

Oscar: Passing kudos along to Alex for rallying the context and keeping the Q&A focused.

kudos-bot: Oscar gave Alex a "Context Captain" kudos (reason: summarized roadmap during outage) :anchor:

Tess: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/teamwork-help-xyz789

Ivy: Also logging a 2-line addendum to the demo checklist: 1) keep PDF backup on desktop, 2) have 1 co-host ready to summarize. I'll PR it today.

Alex: I'll add the co-host rotation to the calendar invite template so demos auto-assign backups.

Rohan: Poll: who wants to volunteer as backup for next week's demos? quick: yes/no

Ivy: yes

Oscar: yes

Tess: yes

Rohan: Great, I'll update the rotation.

Ivy: Thank you everyone  small hiccup, big kindness. Add extra kudos on the board if you like :heart:
